policy.runtime: native Rust only; Postgres (sqlx, Pi read replica + nezopt 15T writer), Firestore (native OAuth/documents/queries/transactions), Redis, direct HTTPS/JSON-RPC
policy.note: No live database, Stripe, chain or SMTP call was made while building or testing. Verification below is unit/domain/router level unless stated otherwise.
policy.firestoreState: balances, ledger, users, orders, addresses, deposits, withdrawals, money requests, notifications, native sales and PKN purchases stay in their real Firestore collections; nothing was migrated to empty SQL tables

routes.implementation: Full POST action surface (plus GET ?action=sold-history). create/checkout (default): validates items, atomically decrements listings in Postgres with rollback, credits sellers minus the 3% commission through the Firestore ledger, routes commission to the treasury, writes marketplace_sales rows with the Node doc-id scheme and an orders/{orderId} document (clientOrderId idempotency). mark-shipped, confirm-delivery (records delivered and, for EUR orders, releases each seller's Stripe Transfer), reveal-shipping, report-problem, cancel-eur/cancel (releases the hold and the held PKN discount), notify-sellers (outbox docs), nft-shipping-request (user_card_collections + nft_shipping_requests documents) and refund (PKN moves through the Firestore ledger inside the refund; EUR calls Stripe refunds + Transfer reversal, idempotent by client token and bounded by the seller's remaining share). notify-sellers now claims the real `order_seller_sale_notifications` marker and delivers through Resend, reusing the same idempotent path as EUR fulfilment. cancel-eur/cancel and the expired/failed webhook branches share the ported `releaseEurReservation` contract. reveal-shipping requires a paid/escrow/released order, 404s without an encrypted snapshot, and returns the decrypted flattened address plus the seller's shipment summary.
routes.verification: Item validation and router wiring tested; decrement SQL ported 1:1 from marketplace-orders.js.

routes.implementation: Verifies the Stripe-Signature HMAC (t + v1 over 't.payload', 300s tolerance) before parsing; per-event-id idempotency; checkout.session.completed routes to PKN credit or marketplace-order paid (marks paid, validates the amount, consumes the held PKN discount, then runs the idempotent EUR fulfilment: commit stock hold, write Sold-on-Pokoin rows, queue seller notifications, record pending_worker steps); a Stripe retry resumes a half-finished fulfilment; expired/failed releases the stock hold. `checkout.session.expired` and `checkout.session.async_payment_failed` run the full `releaseEurReservation` contract (cancelled status, inventory released, held discount returned once, listings restored), with the failed-payment case also releasing an order Stripe left `processing`.
